items.docs:
Getting the products for the UI involves additional steps and the query is slower than the regular get products.
NB: Filtering & sorting is not supported for the following fields: length, delivery_time, packaging_type, alcohol_registry_number, alcohol_percentage
batches, excise_declaration_number, tax_free, is_regular_gift_card, reward_points_not_allowed, non_stock_product, cashier_must_enter_price, labels_not_needed, deposit_fee_amount
